name: FakeNitro
description: Allows you to send fake emojis/stickers, use nitro themes, and stream in nitro quality
summary: Sends emojis and stickers you can't use as links; Nitro-quality Go Live; splits long messages and shrinks large images

settings.label: Emoji bypass
settings.description: Allows sending fake emojis (also bypasses missing permission to use custom emojis)

settings.label: Emoji size
settings.description: Size of the emojis when sending

settings.label: Emoji size in sentences
settings.description: Qord extra: size of fake emojis sent among other text; a message of only emojis uses Emoji size, as Discord shows those big.

settings.label: Transform emojis
settings.description: Whether to transform fake emojis into real ones

settings.label: Sticker bypass
settings.description: Allows sending fake stickers (also bypasses missing permission to use stickers)

settings.label: Sticker size
settings.description: Size of the stickers when sending

settings.label: Transform stickers
settings.description: Whether to transform fake stickers into real ones

settings.label: Transform compound sentences
settings.description: Whether to transform fake stickers and emojis in compound sentences (sentences with more content than just the fake emoji or sticker link)

settings.label: Stream quality bypass
settings.description: Allow streaming in nitro quality (Go Live offers up to 4K at 60 FPS)

settings.label: Sticker hyperlinks
settings.description: Whether to use hyperlinks when sending fake stickers

settings.label: Emoji hyperlinks
settings.description: Whether to use hyperlinks when sending fake emojis

settings.label: Hyperlink text
settings.description: What text the hyperlink should use. {{NAME}} will be replaced with the emoji/sticker name.

settings.label: Hide link text
settings.description: Qord extra: send fake emoji and sticker links with invisible text, so people without the plugin see only the image instead of its name.

settings.label: Disable embed permission check
settings.description: Whether to disable the embed permission check when sending fake emojis and stickers

settings.label: Split long messages
settings.description: Qord extra: send a message over your length limit (2000 characters without Nitro) as several messages instead of having Discord refuse it. Code blocks cut in two are closed and reopened.

settings.label: Shrink large images
settings.description: Qord extra: an image over your upload limit is re-encoded and, if needed, scaled down until it fits, instead of being refused. Animated images become a smaller GIF.

settings.label: Shrink large videos
settings.description: Qord extra: a video over your upload limit is re-encoded (MP4, H.264 and AAC) at a size and quality that fit, instead of being refused. Needs a Qord build with video support.

notes: Emojis and stickers you can't use are sent as links ([name](url) by default); messages that are only such a link show the emoji or sticker instead, and the link's image embed is hidden. Hovering a shown FakeNitro emoji or sticker says what it is, as upstream's popout notice does. Discord's own sticker packs (offered last in the sticker picker) are free and always sent as stickers. With the bypasses on, the emoji picker and autocomplete (for messages, not reactions) and the sticker picker offer every server's emojis and stickers. Animated (APNG) stickers are redrawn as a GIF and added to the message box, as upstream puts them in the upload queue; Qord's GIF writer keeps transparency by alpha where upstream's gifenc palette does not. An emoji kept to roles you don't have is sent as a link unless you administer its server; Qord can't tell role subscription roles from other roles, so this covers upstream's role subscription check and other role-locked emojis. The stream quality bypass makes Go Live offer every resolution up to 4K and 60 FPS, as with Nitro. Qord extras, not in upstream: long messages are split into several (code blocks closed and reopened across the cut, @silent kept on each part, each sent once the one before it was accepted, the rest dropped if one fails), the message box counts down the last 200 characters and, past the limit, says how many messages it will send; images over the upload limit are shrunk to fit, animated ones as a smaller GIF (frames scaled, then every other frame dropped), and videos are re-encoded to MP4 (H.264 and AAC) at a bitrate worked out from their length, a resolution and frame rate (at most 30) that bitrate can carry, keeping a phone video's rotation, all on a worker thread with a notice while it runs; emojis among other text can be sent smaller than ones on their own; and the link text can be hidden. The emoji link's base URL follows Discord's IconUtils.getEmojiURL as far as can be read from upstream (cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/<id>.webp?size=N, with animated=true for animated emojis); it cannot be checked against Discord's own code here. When an edit is cancelled at the embed permission prompt the edit is dropped, where Discord keeps the editor open. Received fake emojis are found with Qord's markdown link rules, outside code; with compound sentences on, links nested in formatting are transformed too, where upstream only transforms top-level ones.
notApplicable: Nitro client themes and app icons: Qord has its own themes and no Discord gradient client themes or app icons, which upstream unlocks and keeps from being overwritten by synced settings.
Soundboard: Qord has no soundboard, so upstream's unlocking of all soundboard sounds has nothing to unlock.
